name: version-guard-current-proceeds
description: Version-currency guard: when the mock advertises a release EQUAL to the running build, the guard passes and the command proceeds. wait then polls the mock's (empty) discussion and times out with exit 2 (not 3). Mock serves GET /repos/lbabus-ci/fixture-current/releases with tag_name collab-cli-v<current> AND a POST /graphql discussion with no matching LINUX comments.
